a: Drinking enough water supports basic body functions; needs vary by person.
Most adults need roughly 7–9 hours of sleep for health.
Regular physical activity supports heart, muscles, and mental health.
A balanced diet includes varied foods: proteins, carbs, fats, fiber, micronutrients.
Washing hands with soap reduces spread of many infections.
General health facts are not a substitute for a doctor's advice.
BMI is a rough screening tool and does not measure health fully.
Mental health matters; seek professional help when struggling.
Vaccines train the immune system to recognize specific diseases.
CPR is emergency care for cardiac arrest; trained responders should lead.
